ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone wants a latrine or toilet within reach, so nobody has to use the bushes or wait in line.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: There are fewer toilets again than {FOR_nameDef} asked for.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony builds {THING}, or any other latrine or toilet.

plain.li: Could we have {THING} closer in? I don't always make it across the yard in time.
[trigger:outside] I had to go behind the woodpile again. Could we build {THING}?
[winter] Squatting in the snow is a miserable way to start the day. Build {THING}, please.
[night] Going out alone in the dark to relieve myself is how people get eaten. Put {THING} near the beds.
[large] There are too many of us for what we have. The line in the morning goes out the door.
[rain] Came back soaked to the knees from a trip that should have taken a minute.
[old] My knees don't like squatting anymore. A seat with walls around it would be a mercy.

warm.li: It's not a glamorous thing to ask for, I know. But {THING} would make everyone's mornings easier.

blunt.li: Build {THING}. I'm done with the bushes.

cheerful.li: Picture it: {THING}, with walls and a door. I'd even take my turn cleaning it.

gloomy.li: One day something will bite me out there while I'm squatting. Then maybe we'll get {THING}.

cold.li: Waste left in the open draws flies and spreads sickness. Building {THING} costs less than an outbreak.

plain.li: A seat, four walls and nobody watching. Thank you.
[large] No more line in the morning.

warm.li: Thank you. I didn't think anyone wanted to hear about it.

cheerful.li: It has a door and everything!

cold.li: Sanitation sorted. Fewer of us will get sick.

plain.li: Back to the bushes, then.

blunt.li: Woodpile it is. Mind where you step.

gloomy.li: We'll all keep going outside until somebody gets sick.

plain.li: Another trip behind the woodpile today. I'm still hoping for {THING}.
[promised] You said we'd get {THING}. I've been counting the days, and the trips.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who has gone grimy wants anywhere at all to wash.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: There's nowhere to wash any more, after {FOR_nameDef} asked for somewhere.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or anywhere else to wash: a bathtub or a shower.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't been able to wash in days and is starting to smell it.

plain.li: There's nowhere to wash. Not even a bucket. Could we build {THING}?
[hot] I've sweated through the same shirt for three days, and there's nowhere to rinse it out, or me.
[afterraid] The raid is still on my hands. I'd like somewhere to wash it off.
[work:Growing] I come in from the fields with half the field on me, and there's nowhere to wash it off.
[child] I'm all sticky and there's nowhere to wash.

warm.li: Even {THING} would do. I'll fill it myself if I have to.

cheerful.li: A tub of water is all I'm asking for. I'll even share it.

gloomy.li: I've started to smell like the midden. Maybe that's just who I am now.

cold.li: Filth breeds disease, and {THING} is cheap.

plain.li: I scrubbed until the water went gray. Thank you.

cheerful.li: Clean hands, clean face, clean everything!

gloomy.li: Clean for now. It won't last.

plain.li: I'll wash in the rain, then.
Still nowhere to wash. People have started standing upwind of me.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: hot water
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A bath or shower that should have been warm came out cold, and the colony knows how to heat water.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The colony has no hot water any more.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING} and a boiler to heat it.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} washed in cold water today, and the colony knows how to heat it.

plain.li: [trigger:coldwater] The water was ice cold this morning. Could we get {THING} and a boiler to go with it?
[winter] Washing in cold water in winter is how people catch their death. We know how to heat it now.
A boiler and {THING}. Then a bath would actually be a bath.

warm.li: Hot water would make the mornings kinder, for all of us.

cheerful.li: Hot water, with steam coming off it! Imagine.

gloomy.li: My teeth are still chattering from this morning's wash.

cold.li: A cold wash puts people off washing. Heated water pays for itself.

plain.li: The water came out steaming this morning. Thank you.

warm.li: Everyone's in a better mood since the water got warm.

cheerful.li: It steams! I stayed in until somebody knocked.

plain.li: Quick washes, then. Very quick.
Another cold wash this morning. I'm still waiting on that boiler.
